note_tweet.text: Arc's gas model, explained simply. 1/ On Arc, USDC is the native gas token, so fees are quoted in dollars instead of a volatile coin. That makes costs predictable for payroll and payments. 2/ The ERC-20 interface at 0x3600 exposes the same balance with 6 decimals while the native view uses 18, so apps must never mix the two in one calculation. 3/ Finality is deterministic and sub-second, which means a payout either happened or it didn't: no waiting for confirmations. 4/ Bottom line: build your accounting in 6-decimal units and treat the 18-decimal value only as gas.
